prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1446; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the left corner, with the tail lamp housing and left quarter panel showing matching scuffs and paint transfer, which fits the low-speed parking lot impact described. Replacement of the bumper cover and lamp assembly with refinishing of the quarter panel is the recommended plan. The labor hours on the estimate run a little high for this scope, so the body shop has been asked to justify them line by line. Two similar charges entered on the same day are being verified before payment. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the records reviewed.
